lead: Giving a `Core` class its card breaks an LSP hover case in another crate.
body: `tests/lsp/hover/a-namespace-segment-answers-what-it-contains.lspt` freezes every class of a namespace with its card's `short`, so the `nvs-lsp` coverage test fails only at `nv verify`. Add the new `short` to that case's line for the class in the same slice as the card.
